description:
Goal
Close the cutover by deleting obsolete vocabulary, updating docs/guides, and pinning telemetry that proves compiler2 has one transport authority.

Required docs
Update outline.md or its successor, proposal.html, .agent docs, and user-facing guides touched by compiler2 runtime transport. They must state the final architecture: shared descriptor interners plus root-scoped TransportPlan facts; semantic evidence is not representation obligation; RuntimeDemand is pre-plan; Shape is settled once and interned all the way down; ValueId maps to ShapeId outside the spine through TransportPosition; CallableId/BoundaryId are fact identities; divergence is is_empty(return_ty); published boundary contracts are BoundaryId columns; codegen reprs are seam facts.

Telemetry signal
Expose final transport-spine/flow events with stable counts for shape nodes, Nothing nodes, lane leaves, tuple nodes, callable nodes, BoundaryIds, TransportPosition mappings, direct callable transports, first-class callable materializations, omitted lanes, and codegen seam facts. Counts alone are not enough: at least one assertion must prove producer return and consumer resume share one ShapeId.

Removal target
Dead TODOs, stale comments saying TrashRuntimeValueLayout or any old name is authority, stale tests asserting TrashRuntimeValueLayout/TrashDeliveredShape/TrashNativeDemandAbi, compatibility switches, old dump sidecars, temporary construction affordances, and any doc language that describes fz-hwn.20 as still future once this closes. If anything temporary remains, create a follow-up ticket before closing this one.

Checks
cargo test --workspace or the agreed compiler2 matrix; cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings; rg confirms removed old-world names are absent or only appear in historical notes that explicitly describe the removed model. rg also confirms ScalarId, LocalCallableId-as-spine, boundary ABI as model language, and codegen-derived shape are absent from live docs/tests.
title: Transport cutover: delete old vocabulary, update docs, and pin final telemetry
